```{r 1}
rm(list = ls())

knit_start_time <- Sys.time()

source("../scripts/00_setup.R")

pacman::p_load(
  knitr,
  nhdplusTools,
  scales,
  sf,
  tidyverse,
  viridis
)

theme_set(theme_bw())

dir_data <- "../data/processed"
dir_figs <- "../figures"

dir.create(dir_figs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

huc_level <- "huc08"
huc_col <- str_replace(huc_level, "huc0", "huc")

min_reaches <- 30
min_months <- 6
coherence_r2 <- 0.8
compromised_threshold <- 5
rebuild_ecoregion_lookup <- FALSE

month_levels <- month.abb

path_metrics <- file.path(dir_data, paste0("06_", huc_level, "_allometry_metrics.csv"))
path_diagnostics <- file.path(dir_data, paste0("06_", huc_level, "_diagnostics.csv"))
path_flowlines <- file.path(dir_data, "riv_pfaf_7_MERIT_Hydro_v07_Basins_v01_CONUS.shp")
path_coherence <- file.path(
  dir_data,
  "06a_null_coherence",
  paste0("06a_", huc_level, "_observed_vs_null_coherence.csv")
)

path_ecoregion_lookup <- file.path(dir_data, "08a_huc08_l2_ecoregion_lookup.csv")
path_ecoregion_flux_summary <- file.path(dir_data, "08a_l2_ecoregion_flux_summary.csv")
path_ecoregion_gap_summary <- file.path(dir_data, "08a_l2_ecoregion_gpp_er_gap_summary.csv")
path_ecoregion_null_summary <- file.path(dir_data, "08a_l2_ecoregion_null_coherence_summary.csv")

# ArcGIS REST FeatureServer query for North American Level II terrestrial ecoregions.
# This pulls only Level II code/name plus geometry as GeoJSON, then caches only a
# small HUC8-to-ecoregion lookup table locally.
ecoregion_l2_url <- paste0(
  "https://services7.arcgis.com/oF9CDB4lUYF7Um9q/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "NA_Terrestrial_Ecoregions_Level_2/FeatureServer/3/query?",
  "where=1%3D1",
  "&outFields=LEVEL1%2CNameL1_En%2CLEVEL2%2CNameL2_En%2CL2Key_En",
  "&returnGeometry=true",
  "&outSR=4326",
  "&f=geojson"
)

```

## Goal

This notebook asks whether HUC8-scale GPP and ER allometries vary systematically across Level II ecoregions. The intent is descriptive stratification: ecoregions are used to summarize where scaling patterns occur, not to infer that ecoregion membership causes those scaling patterns.

**My take:** 

```{r 2}

metrics <- read_csv(path_metrics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"),
    month = factor(month, levels = month_levels),
    metabolism = recode(
      metabolism_var,
      c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = "GPP",
      c_er_flux_gO2_d = "ER"
    ),
    coherent = n >= min_reaches & r2 >= coherence_r2,
    slope_class = case_when(
      slope < 0.8 ~ "Sublinear",
      slope <= 1.2 ~ "Linear",
      slope > 1.2 ~ "Superlinear",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    slope_class = factor(slope_class, levels = c("Sublinear", "Linear", "Superlinear"))
  )

diagnostics <- read_csv(path_diagnostics, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"),
    n_reaches_removed = replace_na(n_reaches_removed, 0),
    pct_reaches_removed = replace_na(pct_reaches_removed, 0),
    length_removed_km = replace_na(length_removed_km, 0),
    pct_length_removed = replace_na(pct_length_removed, 0),
    likely_allometry_sensitive = replace_na(likely_allometry_sensitive, FALSE),
    compromised = pct_reaches_removed >= compromised_threshold |
      pct_length_removed >= compromised_threshold |
      likely_allometry_sensitive
  )

allometry <- metrics |>
  inner_join(diagnostics, by = c("huc_level", "huc")) |>
  filter(
    n >= min_reaches,
    is.finite(slope),
    is.finite(r2)
  )

annual_slopes <- allometry |>
  group_by(huc, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    annual_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_r2 = median(r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_coherent_months = mean(coherent, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    n_months = n_distinct(month),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_months >= min_months)

annual_pairs <- annual_slopes |>
  select(huc, metabolism, annual_slope, annual_r2, pct_coherent_months, n_months) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metabolism,
    values_from = c(annual_slope, annual_r2, pct_coherent_months, n_months)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    diagnostics |>
      select(huc, compromised),
    by = "huc"
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(annual_slope_GPP),
    is.finite(annual_slope_ER)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    annual_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er = annual_slope_GPP - annual_slope_ER,
    gpp_greater_than_er = annual_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er > 0
  )

monthly_pairs <- allometry |>
  select(huc, month, metabolism, slope, r2, coherent) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metabolism,
    values_from = c(slope, r2, coherent)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    diagnostics |>
      select(huc, compromised),
    by = "huc"
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(slope_GPP),
    is.finite(slope_ER)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    slope_gap_gpp_minus_er = slope_GPP - slope_ER,
    both_coherent = coherent_GPP & coherent_ER
  )

coherence <- if (file.exists(path_coherence)) {
  read_csv(path_coherence, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"),
      month = factor(month, levels = month_levels),
      metabolism = recode(
        metabolism_var,
        c_gpp_flux_gO2_d = "GPP",
        c_er_flux_gO2_d = "ER"
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(r2), !is.na(r2_null_95))
} else {
  tibble()
}

```

## Build or read the HUC8 ecoregion lookup

This section uses a lightweight API route. It queries the ArcGIS REST service for Level II North American terrestrial ecoregions, assigns each HUC8 to the Level II ecoregion containing its point-on-surface, and saves only the small HUC8 lookup table. The ecoregion polygons themselves are not saved.

**My take:** 

```{r 3}

build_huc_ecoregion_lookup <- function() {
  flowlines_sf <- read_sf(path_flowlines) |>
    clean_names()
  
  huc_boundaries <- nhdplusTools::get_huc(
    AOI = st_as_sfc(st_bbox(flowlines_sf)),
    type = huc_level,
    t_srs = 4326
  ) |>
    clean_names() |>
    mutate(
      huc = str_pad(as.character(.data[[huc_col]]), width = 8, pad = "0")
    ) |>
    select(huc)
  
  ecoregions_l2_raw <- read_sf(ecoregion_l2_url) |>
    clean_names()
  
  message("Available Level II ecoregion fields: ", paste(names(ecoregions_l2_raw), collapse = ", "))
  
  first_existing <- function(x, candidates) {
    hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(x)][1]
    if (is.na(hit)) {
      rep(NA_character_, nrow(x))
    } else {
      as.character(x[[hit]])
    }
  }
  
  ecoregions_l2 <- ecoregions_l2_raw |>
    mutate(
      l1_code = first_existing(ecoregions_l2_raw, c("level1", "l1_code")),
      l1_ecoregion = first_existing(ecoregions_l2_raw, c("name_l1_en", "na_l1name")),
      l2_code = first_existing(ecoregions_l2_raw, c("level2", "l2_code")),
      l2_ecoregion = first_existing(ecoregions_l2_raw, c("name_l2_en", "na_l2name"))
    ) |>
    select(l1_code, l1_ecoregion, l2_code, l2_ecoregion, geometry) |>
    st_transform(st_crs(huc_boundaries))
  
  huc_lookup <- huc_boundaries |>
    st_point_on_surface() |>
    st_join(ecoregions_l2, join = st_within) |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    select(huc, l1_code, l1_ecoregion, l2_code, l2_ecoregion) |>
    distinct() |>
    arrange(huc)
  
  write_csv(huc_lookup, path_ecoregion_lookup)
  
  huc_lookup
}

huc_ecoregions <- if (file.exists(path_ecoregion_lookup) & !rebuild_ecoregion_lookup) {
  read_csv(path_ecoregion_lookup, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(huc = str_pad(as.character(huc), width = 8, pad = "0"))
} else {
  build_huc_ecoregion_lookup()
}

ecoregion_check <- huc_ecoregions |>
  count(l1_ecoregion, l2_code, l2_ecoregion, sort = TRUE)

ecoregion_check |>
  kable(digits = 1)

```

```{r 4}

annual_ecoregion <- annual_slopes |>
  left_join(huc_ecoregions, by = "huc") |>
  left_join(
    diagnostics |>
      select(huc, compromised),
    by = "huc"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(l2_ecoregion))

monthly_ecoregion <- allometry |>
  left_join(huc_ecoregions, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(l2_ecoregion))

annual_pairs_ecoregion <- annual_pairs |>
  left_join(huc_ecoregions, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(l2_ecoregion))

monthly_pairs_ecoregion <- monthly_pairs |>
  left_join(huc_ecoregions, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(l2_ecoregion))

coherence_ecoregion <- coherence |>
  left_join(huc_ecoregions, by = "huc") |>
  filter(!is.na(l2_ecoregion))

ecoregion_order <- annual_ecoregion |>
  filter(metabolism == "GPP") |>
  group_by(l2_ecoregion) |>
  summarise(
    median_gpp_slope = median(annual_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_gpp_slope) |>
  pull(l2_ecoregion)

annual_ecoregion <- annual_ecoregion |>
  mutate(l2_ecoregion = factor(l2_ecoregion, levels = ecoregion_order))

monthly_ecoregion <- monthly_ecoregion |>
  mutate(l2_ecoregion = factor(l2_ecoregion, levels = ecoregion_order))

annual_pairs_ecoregion <- annual_pairs_ecoregion |>
  mutate(l2_ecoregion = factor(l2_ecoregion, levels = ecoregion_order))

monthly_pairs_ecoregion <- monthly_pairs_ecoregion |>
  mutate(l2_ecoregion = factor(l2_ecoregion, levels = ecoregion_order))

coherence_ecoregion <- coherence_ecoregion |>
  mutate(l2_ecoregion = factor(l2_ecoregion, levels = ecoregion_order))

ecoregion_plot_height <- max(7, 0.35 * length(ecoregion_order))

```

## How do GPP and ER slopes vary across Level II ecoregions?

**My take:** 

```{r 5}

p_annual_slope_ecoregion <- annual_ecoregion |>
  ggplot(aes(x = annual_slope, y = l2_ecoregion, fill = metabolism)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual HUC8 GPP and ER allometric slopes by Level II ecoregion",
    x = "Median annual HUC8 allometric slope",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Flux"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p_annual_slope_ecoregion

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "08a_l2_ecoregion_annual_slope_boxplot.png"),
  p_annual_slope_ecoregion,
  width = 9,
  height = ecoregion_plot_height,
  dpi = 300
)

```

## Where do GPP and ER scaling rules diverge?

Positive values mean GPP has the steeper annual allometric slope. Negative values mean ER has the steeper annual allometric slope.

**My take:** 

```{r 6}

p_annual_gap_ecoregion <- annual_pairs_ecoregion |>
  ggplot(aes(x = annual_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er, y = l2_ecoregion)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey70", outlier.alpha = 0.25) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual GPP minus ER allometric slope gap by Level II ecoregion",
    x = "Annual slope gap: GPP - ER",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_annual_gap_ecoregion

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "08a_l2_ecoregion_gpp_minus_er_slope_gap.png"),
  p_annual_gap_ecoregion,
  width = 8,
  height = ecoregion_plot_height,
  dpi = 300
)

```

## Are ecoregion patterns seasonal?

This heatmap shows the median monthly HUC8 allometric slope within each Level II ecoregion. It is a compact way to see whether ecoregion separation is persistent or season-specific.

**My take:** 

```{r 7}

monthly_ecoregion_summary <- monthly_ecoregion |>
  group_by(l2_ecoregion, month, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    n_huc8 = n_distinct(huc),
    median_slope = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_huc8 >= 5)

p_monthly_slope_heatmap <- monthly_ecoregion_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = l2_ecoregion, fill = median_slope)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(median_slope, 2)), size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly median HUC8 allometric slope by Level II ecoregion",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Median\nslope"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_monthly_slope_heatmap

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "08a_l2_ecoregion_monthly_slope_heatmap.png"),
  p_monthly_slope_heatmap,
  width = 11,
  height = ecoregion_plot_height,
  dpi = 300
)

```

## Do ecoregion differences persist after excluding compromised HUC8s?

This is a quick sensitivity check. "Compromised" follows the centroid-filter diagnostics from the 06 workflow. It does not mean the HUC8 is unusable; it only flags HUC8s where removed reaches may have enough leverage to matter.

**My take:** 

```{r 8}

sensitivity_summary <- bind_rows(
  annual_ecoregion |>
    mutate(screen = "All HUC8s"),
  annual_ecoregion |>
    filter(!compromised) |>
    mutate(screen = "Uncompromised only")
) |>
  group_by(screen, l2_ecoregion, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    n_huc8 = n_distinct(huc),
    median_slope = median(annual_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_huc8 >= 5) |>
  mutate(screen = factor(screen, levels = c("All HUC8s", "Uncompromised only")))

p_sensitivity <- sensitivity_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = median_slope, y = l2_ecoregion, color = screen)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(l2_ecoregion, metabolism)), color = "grey75") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolism, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity of ecoregion median slopes to compromised-HUC8 exclusion",
    x = "Median annual HUC8 allometric slope",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_sensitivity

ggsave(
  file.path(dir_figs, "08a_l2_ecoregion_slope_sensitivity_compromised_hucs.png"),
  p_sensitivity,
  width = 10,
  height = ecoregion_plot_height,
  dpi = 300
)

```

## How does null-model support vary across ecoregions?

This summarizes the 06a null-model coherence results by ecoregion. It is still descriptive: a high ecoregion value means that HUC8-month tests in that ecoregion often exceeded the shuffled-network null, not that ecoregion properties caused the coherence.

**My take:** 

```{r 9}

if (nrow(coherence_ecoregion) > 0) {
  ecoregion_null_summary <- coherence_ecoregion |>
    group_by(l2_ecoregion, metabolism) |>
    summarise(
      n_tests = n(),
      n_huc8 = n_distinct(huc),
      pct_observed_coherent = mean(observed_coherent, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      pct_stronger_than_null = mean(stronger_than_null, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      pct_rcc_like_coherent = mean(rcc_like_coherent, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      median_r2_margin = median(r2_minus_null_95, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(n_huc8 >= 5)
  
  write_csv(ecoregion_null_summary, path_ecoregion_null_summary)
  
  p_null_ecoregion <- ecoregion_null_summary |>
    ggplot(aes(x = pct_rcc_like_coherent, y = l2_ecoregion, fill = metabolism)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    labs(
      title = "RCC-like coherent HUC8-month tests by Level II ecoregion",
      x = "RCC-like coherent tests (%)",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Flux"
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  p_null_ecoregion
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(dir_figs, "08a_l2_ecoregion_rcc_like_coherence.png"),
    p_null_ecoregion,
    width = 9,
    height = ecoregion_plot_height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

```

## Compact summary tables

**My take:** 

```{r 10}

ecoregion_flux_summary <- annual_ecoregion |>
  group_by(l1_ecoregion, l2_code, l2_ecoregion, metabolism) |>
  summarise(
    n_huc8 = n_distinct(huc),
    n_compromised_huc8 = n_distinct(huc[compromised]),
    pct_compromised_huc8 = n_compromised_huc8 / n_huc8 * 100,
    median_annual_slope = median(annual_slope, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_annual_slope = quantile(annual_slope, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_annual_slope = quantile(annual_slope, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_annual_r2 = median(annual_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pct_coherent_months = median(pct_coherent_months, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(metabolism, median_annual_slope)

ecoregion_gap_summary <- annual_pairs_ecoregion |>
  group_by(l1_ecoregion, l2_code, l2_ecoregion) |>
  summarise(
    n_huc8 = n_distinct(huc),
    n_compromised_huc8 = n_distinct(huc[compromised]),
    pct_compromised_huc8 = n_compromised_huc8 / n_huc8 * 100,
    median_gpp_slope = median(annual_slope_GPP, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_er_slope = median(annual_slope_ER, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er = median(annual_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er = quantile(annual_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er = quantile(annual_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_gpp_slope_greater_than_er = mean(gpp_greater_than_er, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_slope_gap_gpp_minus_er)

write_csv(ecoregion_flux_summary, path_ecoregion_flux_summary)
write_csv(ecoregion_gap_summary, path_ecoregion_gap_summary)

ecoregion_flux_summary |>
  kable(digits = 2)

ecoregion_gap_summary |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```

## Initial interpretation notes

Use this section as a running scratchpad for interpretation after inspecting the figures and tables.

**My take:** 

- 

```{r 11}

Sys.time() - knit_start_time

```
